name: Improved Sake Affinity
body:
Your affinity for alcohol unlocks additional abilities.

Prerequisites: tanuki, sake affinity species trait, sufficiently high level (see table).

Benefit: Choose one spell from the table below; by taking a swig of alcohol, you can expend one daily use of your expeditious retreat ability to gain the benefits of this spell. The duration of the effect is always 1 minute, regardless of its usual duration.

Special: You may take this feat multiple times. Each time you select it, you may select another spell from the table. To select a spell, you must meet the minimum character level for its listing in the table.

Spell	Min. Level
Divine favor	3rd
False life	5th
Rage	7th
